article.title: English to Hindi: Expressing feelings
article.description: English: 'I'm really looking forward to the weekend.' Hindi: 'मुझे सप्ताहांत का बेसब्री से इंतज़ार है।' Teaching point: 'looking forward to' has no single-word Hindi equivalent — 'बेसब्री से इंतज़ार' (eagerly waiting) captures the same excited-anticipation meaning.
article.content: English: 'I'm really looking forward to the weekend.' Hindi: 'मुझे सप्ताहांत का बेसब्री से इंतज़ार है।' Teaching point: 'looking forward to' has no single-word Hindi equivalent — 'बेसब्री से इंतज़ार' (eagerly waiting) captures the same excited-anticipation meaning.

slides.headlineRest: — How to Express Eager Anticipation in Hindi
slides.body: The phrase 'looking forward to' expresses eager anticipation or excitement about something in the future. It signifies that you are genuinely enthusiastic for an upcoming event. Interestingly, there isn't a direct single-word Hindi equivalent for this feeling. Instead, we use the phrase 'बेसब्री से इंतज़ार' (besabri se intazar), which means 'eagerly waiting', to perfectly capture this sense of excited anticipation. For example: 'I'm really looking forward to the weekend.' translates to 'मुझे सप्ताहांत का बेसब्री से इंतज़ार है।'
slides.hindiSummary: किसी चीज़ का बेसब्री से इंतज़ार करना मतलब 'looking forward to' होना।
